description:
You are an urban planning consultant analyzing political influence zones and regional connectivity around world capital cities. Your team needs circular zones representing the approximate regional reach of each national capital for a comparative governance study.

Using gvSIG Desktop and the populated places layer at /home/ga/gvsig_data/cities/ne_110m_populated_places.shp, create buffer zones of 2 geographic degrees radius around every feature where the FEATURECLA field equals 'Admin-0 capital' (national capitals of sovereign states). Export the buffer polygons — one polygon per capital, preserving all original point attribute fields — as a new shapefile to /home/ga/gvsig_exports/capital_buffers.shp.

The output must contain polygon geometries (not points), and each polygon must correspond to exactly one capital city with its original attributes attached.
